ThingDef.label: predator reflex organ
ThingDef.description: A grown Wraith reflex symbiote that knots itself around motor pathways and accelerates close-combat reactions without replacing the host's own nervous system.

ThingDef.label: myomer reinforcement gland
ThingDef.description: A cultured organ that seeds contractile Wraith myomers through major muscle groups, improving strength and fine physical control.

ThingDef.label: regenerative vesicle
ThingDef.description: A compact reservoir of repair tissue that slowly closes ordinary injuries and supports damaged physiology. It cannot reconstruct missing limbs or duplicate full Wraith regeneration.

ThingDef.label: metabolic reserve node
ThingDef.description: A living biochemical reservoir that reduces food and sleep pressure while preserving the host's normal biological needs.

ThingDef.label: sensory crown organ
ThingDef.description: A fan of cultured neural tissue that expands sensory integration, sharpening sight, hearing and subtle psychic perception.

ThingDef.label: vital feedback organ
ThingDef.description: A deliberately hostile symbiote trained on the transfer signature of Wraith feeding. When Drain Life establishes contact it collapses the transfer channel and drives a violent feedback pulse into the feeding Wraith. The bearer still suffers a smaller physiological shock.

ThingDef.label: nanite motor lattice
ThingDef.description: A precise Asuran nanite mesh woven through motor pathways to improve movement, manipulation and weapon-handling response.

ThingDef.label: autonomic efficiency lattice
ThingDef.description: A distributed Asuran controller that trims metabolic waste and accelerates restorative sleep without removing ordinary hunger or rest needs.

ThingDef.label: adaptive sensor mesh
ThingDef.description: A clean precursor nanite sensor layer that continuously correlates visual, auditory and weapon-alignment information.

ThingDef.label: reconstruction microforge
ThingDef.description: A miniature nanite maintenance forge that slowly repairs ordinary injuries. It is intentionally far below a true Asuran pattern-reconstruction system and cannot restore missing anatomy or a dead person.

ThingDef.label: EMP shunt lattice
ThingDef.description: A hardened nanite distribution mesh that rapidly reroutes around EMP-disrupted coordination nodes. It shortens human-form nanite disruption rather than making nanites immune to EMP.

ThingDef.label: sovereign neural lattice
ThingDef.description: An expensive cross-technology neural lattice built from Asuran coordination theory, recovered Ancient control architecture and Replicator command structure. It can qualify its bearer for Ancient control-chair operation and transmit a bounded single-target sovereign directive to WNG Replicators. It does not make the bearer a Replicator Queen.
